title: Nerolidol-loaded beta-cyclodextrin nanoparticles modulate Nrf-2/Keap1/NF-kappaB signaling to inhibit DMBA-induced mammary carcinogenesis in Sprague-Dawley rats.
authors: Venkatesan, Kamalesh Balakumar; Alamelu, Saravanan; Srinivasan, Manoj Kumar; Pachaiappan, Pugalendhi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究纳米颗粒调节Nrf-2/Keap1/NF-kappaB信号通路抑制大鼠乳腺癌，核心为小分子-蛋白信号通路与体内药效，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Breast cancer remains a major health concern among women, necessitating innovative therapeutic strategies. This study investigates the effect of nerolidol-loaded beta-cyclodextrin nanoparticles (NER-betaCD-NPs) on the Nrf-2/Keap1/NF-kappaB signaling pathway in 7,12-dimethylbenz(a)anthracene (DMBA)-induced mammary carcinogenesis in Sprague-Dawley rats. Network pharmacology identified 18 key genes linked to nerolidol anticancer action, with pathway enrichment analyses revealing roles in xenobiotic metabolism, antioxidant defense, and inflammatory regulation. Molecular docking demonstrated strong binding affinities of nerolidol with Nrf-2, Keap1, NQO1, HO-1, and NF-kappaB, supporting its therapeutic relevance. In vivo, DMBA exposure elevated lipid peroxidation and phase I enzyme activity while depleting antioxidants and phase II detoxification enzymes. Oral administration of NER-betaCD-NPs (5, 10, and 20 mg/kg b.w.) significantly restored biochemical parameters, reduced tumor burden and incidence, and improved lipid profile and antioxidant enzyme levels. Histopathological observations confirmed the reversal of DMBA-induced mammary tissue damage. Molecular analyses revealed downregulation of NF-kappaB and Keap1, with concomitant upregulation of Nrf-2, NQO1, and HO-1, indicating effective modulation of oxidative and inflammatory pathways. Western blot and qRT-PCR analyses further validated the molecular impact of NER-betaCD-NPs on key signaling molecules. Overall, NER-betaCD-NPs exhibit potent chemoprotective effects against DMBA-induced mammary carcinogenesis by targeting the Nrf-2/Keap1/NF-kappaB, mitigating oxidative stress, and suppressing inflammatory signaling. These results highlight the potential of NER-betaCD-NPs as a promising nanotherapeutic approach for breast cancer management.
abstract_zh: 乳腺癌仍然是女性健康的一大隐患，亟需创新的治疗策略。本研究探讨了负载橙花叔醇的β-环糊精纳米颗粒（NER-betaCD-NPs）对7,12-二甲基苯并(a)蒽（DMBA）诱导的Sprague-Dawley大鼠乳腺致癌过程中Nrf-2/Keap1/NF-kappaB信号通路的影响。网络药理学鉴定了18个与橙花叔醇抗癌作用相关的关键基因，通路富集分析揭示了其在异生物代谢、抗氧化防御和炎症调节中的作用。分子对接显示橙花叔醇与Nrf-2、Keap1、NQO1、HO-1和NF-kappaB具有强结合亲和力，支持其治疗相关性。在体内实验中，DMBA暴露提高了脂质过氧化和I相酶活性，同时耗竭了抗氧化剂和II相解毒酶。口服NER-betaCD-NPs（5、10和20 mg/kg体重）显著恢复了生化参数，减少了肿瘤负担和发生率，并改善了脂质谱和抗氧化酶水平。组织病理学观察证实了DMBA诱导的乳腺组织损伤的逆转。分子分析显示NF-kappaB和Keap1下调，同时Nrf-2、NQO1和HO-1上调，表明氧化和炎症通路得到有效调节。Western blot和qRT-PCR分析进一步验证了NER-betaCD-NPs对关键信号分子的分子影响。总体而言，NER-betaCD-NPs通过靶向Nrf-2/Keap1/NF-kappaB通路，减轻氧化应激并抑制炎症信号，对DMBA诱导的乳腺致癌表现出强效的化学保护作用。这些结果突显了NER-betaCD-NPs作为乳腺癌管理中有前景的纳米治疗方法的潜力。
